Quick tech inputs for the SLO/canary ask:

- Proposed SLO: 99.5% p95 latency <= 350ms for production inference (subject to model selection).
- Canary approach: 2-week canary with 10% traffic ramp and automated fallback to smaller variant if error rate > 1.5% or latencies exceed p95 threshold.
- Risk: model quantization may change quality slightly; recommend a short eval set run during canary window.

Linking the canary runbook and perf snapshot here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0Bz-Redwood/QBR-acmepay
